workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots where they are both free next week (all times Eastern):
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Please check these against Elena's and David's calendars and let me know which of these times works for them too. I'll then book it.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. Of the times you suggested, only Thursday at 14:30 works for them. Please go ahead and book that time.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks, Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's over to you to send the confirmation email.

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

This email confirms that the partners' meeting has been scheduled for next week.

All the best,

Brad
